title: Event and Photographer Identification
description: A Twitter user shared three photos of an event.

questions.label: Which event is being celebrated in the photos?
Which two photos were taken by the same person (left 1, right 2 and 3)?
The two photos mentioned above were taken in the same city. The photographer was previously in a different city. Find out the name of that city.

hint: Check the photos on https://www.gettyimages.com/ to identify the person who took the photo, and through them, you will be able to find the city where it happened.
